known_fixture_camera.required_camera: 320x240 RGB, 68 degree HFOV, 0.55 m height, 0.20 m offset

training_scene_camera.requirement: verify builder construction and camera capture on these families before collection

seed_policy: deterministic pose schedule; no random layout regeneration

camera.timestamp_source: native rendering_time and rendering_frame from same cloned frame snapshot
camera.timestamp_policy: record actual values; require strict acquisition-order increase; never infer time from frame index

scene_adapter.collision_geometry: preserve each builder box collision flag

acquisition.process_unit: one complete appearance family per process
acquisition.history: four immediately preceding query captures, newest-first; decisions use only frames 3-8 within each segment

label.target: camera optical-center XY within 0.5 m of requested goal reference camera optical center
label.decision_input: RGB history, ordered RGB references, requested goal image identity only

acquisition.frame_identity_policy: globally unique immutable IDs; references and queries are distinct acquisition records

exclusions.rule: never read or import old RGB, labels, outcomes, pilot outputs, or sealed heldout assets

wall_budget.scope: each family process, including startup, stage construction, warmup, all captures, incremental persistence, SDK close, child reap, and final ledger; no additional 190-second cap
wall_budget.prior_190_second_cap: applied to the separate 144-frame two-room pilot only; it does not cap this 880-image proposal
